create_cut_equal_bins: create equal-width bins to discretize a numeric array into categorical intervals
create_cut_custom_bins: create custom non-uniform bins from a sequence of scalars to bin numeric values
create_cut_with_labels: create binned categorical output with custom labels and ordered categories
create_qcut_quantiles: create quantile-based equal-sized buckets from a numeric array
create_qcut_custom_quantiles: create quantile bins from a custom array of quantile values like deciles
